handbookNote: Batch-2 depth expansion for Montana Code Annotated Title 1, Chapter 5, Part 6 (Revised Uniform Law on Notarial Acts, MCA 1-5-601 to 1-5-632). Batch 1 (mt_notary.json, 67 questions) covered the core provisions section-by-section; this batch goes deeper into the same statute rather than re-covering it: (1) the federal/tribal/foreign notarial-act recognition provisions (1-5-606, -607, -608, -631) that batch 1 never touched, fetched fresh from mca.legmt.gov/archive.legmt.gov for this batch since the original temp/handbooks/mt/notary.txt research explicitly only gave a 'selected' subset of the 36 defined terms in 1-5-602 and omitted these five sections entirely; (2) the remaining untapped 1-5-602 definitions, 1-5-621 discipline grounds, 1-5-622 refusal provisions, 1-5-625/626/632 prohibited-acts/fee/unlawful-acts subsections, and 1-5-619/620 application/education subsections that batch 1 left unused; and (3) scenario/application questions that apply both batches' rules to concrete fact patterns (bond lapses, expired ID edge cases, representative-capacity signings, remote-notarization jurisdiction edge cases, fee-cap combinations, journal/recordkeeping error patterns) rather than restating them as bare recall. Price matches this project's established Notary tier ($9.99), same as batch 1. Question IDs auto-prefix with mt_notary-b2- via build-track-batch.js, so there is no collision risk with batch 1's mt_notary-b1- IDs.
